mission: Balance reactive oxygen species production and clearance so net oxidative pressure stays within tolerable limits.

stage2a.operation: Enzyme clearance capacity is distinguished from net ROS generation and from precursor ownership. Retain low-status context and do not add other minerals merely by enzyme membership.

existing_findings.proposition: Mammalian cells clear superoxide and hydrogen peroxide with superoxide dismutase, catalase and glutathione peroxidase. Copper, zinc, manganese, selenium and glutathione belong to those enzymes. That membership is not an intake result.

existing_source_assessments.label: Weydert and Cullen (2010)
existing_source_assessments.directional_finding: Superoxide dismutase, catalase and glutathione peroxidase are the three primary clearance enzymes. Copper-zinc and manganese forms of superoxide dismutase are named, and glutathione peroxidase requires glutathione and is a selenoprotein.

existing_findings.disposition: Existing canonical assessment retained; enrichment is additive. No clinical or source-level negative inferred from bounded retrieval.

existing_findings.proposition: Glutathione participates in peroxidase clearance of peroxides. That role is biochemical. It is not evidence for eating glutathione.

existing_source_assessments.label: Weydert and Cullen (2010)
existing_source_assessments.directional_finding: Glutathione peroxidase requires reduced glutathione. The paper does not test eating glutathione.

existing_findings.disposition: Existing canonical assessment retained; enrichment is additive. No clinical or source-level negative inferred from bounded retrieval.

existing_findings.proposition: Dietary selenium restores plasma glutathione peroxidase activity in selenium-deficient adults up to a plateau near 35 micrograms a day. Intake above that plateau did not raise the enzyme further.

existing_source_assessments.label: Xia et al. (2010)
existing_source_assessments.directional_finding: Plasma glutathione peroxidase activity in selenium-deficient adults levelled off at about 35 micrograms of selenium a day. Higher doses did not raise it further.

existing_findings.disposition: Existing canonical assessment retained; enrichment is additive. No clinical or source-level negative inferred from bounded retrieval.

existing_findings.proposition: Copper repletion raised erythrocyte superoxide dismutase in infants with marginal copper status. Adding copper to the assay tube did not raise the enzyme, so the change tracked copper nutrition rather than copper in the test.

existing_source_assessments.label: Uauy et al. (1985)
existing_source_assessments.directional_finding: Red-cell superoxide dismutase rose after copper supplementation in infants with marginal copper status and correlated with plasma copper.

existing_findings.disposition: Existing canonical assessment retained; enrichment is additive. No clinical or source-level negative inferred from bounded retrieval.

stage2a.evidence_enrichment: Superoxide/peroxide clearance, selenium repletion and infant copper/SOD responses are distinct from whole-organism net oxidative pressure. Selenium intake plateaus differ by measured selenoprotein.

source_to_claim_records.proposition: Selenomethionine repletion restored plasma GPX3 to a plateau in selenium-deficient adults.
source_to_claim_records.limitation: GPX3 and SEPP1 plateaux differ; neither net oxidative pressure nor neuronal function was measured.
source_to_claim_records.retrieval: Primary full text including GPX/SEPP1 distinction.

source_to_claim_records.proposition: Copper repletion increased erythrocyte SOD in infants with marginal status.
source_to_claim_records.limitation: Selected infant/deficiency context; not general benefits of extra copper or brain SOD measurement.

stage2a.coverage_limitations: Existing source assessments and full attached bibliography are inventoried and preserved. Targeted source retrieval is bounded to the stated propositions; unrefreshed clinical/Phenome sources are not newly validated. No evidence of absence is inferred.
stage2a.stop_rationale: Preserve the complete baseline, add the bounded supported evidence and exact qualifications, and park material attribution/traceability questions for approval instead of forcing an admission or expanding to a comprehensive rebuild.
